description: The line plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) percentage of different editing methods applied to BioGPT and Llama2 models, as a function of the co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^0 to 10^3. The y-axis, labeled "ACC (%)", represents the accuracy percentage, ranging from 0 to 55%. The plot includes six lines, each representing a different editing method: Base (black line with circle markers), MEND (brown line with diamond markers), FT (blue line with triangle markers), MEMIT (purple line with pentagon markers), IKE (red line with triangle markers), and ROME (green line with square markers). The Base line remains relatively flat, indicating a consistent accuracy across the co-occurrence numbers. The MEND line shows a gradual increase in accuracy as the co-occurrence number increases. The FT line also shows a steady increase, with a more pronounced rise after the co-occurrence number reaches 10^2. The MEMIT line follows a similar trend to FT but with a slightly lower accuracy. The IKE line shows a moderate increase in accuracy, with a peak at the co-occurrence number of 10^2. The ROME line exhibits the highest accuracy, with a steep increase, particularly after the co-occurrence number of 10^2, reaching the highest accuracy percentage of the plot at 10^3.
